The '''Spira Security Police''' were the local security force on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]]. They wore off-white tunics, khaki knee-length shorts, brown [[Leather/Legends|leather]] shoes, and tan socks. They carried [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] in hip-holsters, and were responsible for the [[Standard day/Legends|day]]-to-day law enforcement on the planet while Imperial forces patrolled Spira's airspace. The Security Police answered directly to the [[Tourist Guild]] who ruled the planet under lease from the Empire, but cooperation between the police and the local Imperial garrison was regular and cordial.
